questions: What is bias?
If there is bias, was anyone trying to be unfair?
What does significance mean?
If something has significance, does that mean it matters a lot?
What is a confidence interval?
If a confidence interval gets narrower, are you more confident?
What is a model?
If a model fits perfectly, does that prove it is right?
What is an outlier?
If an outlier is far away, should you always remove it?
What is correlation?
If the correlation is strong, did one thing make the other happen?
What is regression?
If there is regression, has something gone backward?
What is precision?
If precision is high, is the result necessarily close to the truth?
What is power?
If power is high, does that mean the effect is large?
What is a signal?
If the signal is weak, should you turn it up?
What is a distribution?
If the distribution changes, did something have to be moved?
What is a population?
If the population doubles, do you automatically have twice as much data?
What does balance mean?
If the balance is perfect, are the groups the same?
What is a treatment?
If the treatment has no effect, was nobody helped?
What is error?
If the error is zero, was the result correct?
